The drain is an API for programmatic callers such as Cloud Agent; `kilo2 run` does not call it. The v1 headless-run assertions are native upstream: packages/cli/src/run/noninteractive.ts (upstream #60699, #61911) waits for the background jobs, subagents and follow-up runs its prompt started before the run exits, and cancels them on abort. Dropped on purpose: the v1 assertion that a run (`--session`, `--continue`) also waits for older background work its prompt did not start, and stops it on abort. Upstream filters its wait to jobs started at or after the prompt's admission (noninteractive.ts `background`), because on a shared server another client can own older jobs; a caller that needs the whole session tree to go quiet calls the drain RPC. Summarize and intake work are executions on v2, so Session.wait covers them; the drain is keyed by session ID, so the v1 cross-directory scenarios collapse into the other-Location test of the plugin suite.
